title: Acacia Switchback
description: A bright seven-eighth dance keeps moving its longer step. An ascending call is answered by clipped chord pairs, then the bass shifts the balance from two-two-three to three-two-two. The middle briefly opens into Lydian colour; the final ascent stops cleanly rather than fading.
technical_note: Let the changing long beat remain buoyant. Keep the right-hand offbeat chords separate from the lower anchors and avoid accenting every short note. The register moves are prepared by longer notes or rests.

performance.note: Deliberate dance pulse, shaped phrases and terraced dynamics; no random timing.

composition_time_source: Recorded when the first score was saved.

audio_reverb.description: Subtle warm room; preserve the clarity of moving voices.
